functions.name: buffAlloc1
functions.purpose: Allocate a one-dimensional buffer and initialize its bound and position.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; allocation failures are not checked.

functions.name: buffRealloc1
functions.purpose: Resize a buffer and clamp its position to the new bound.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; realloc failure is not checked.

functions.name: buffFree1
functions.purpose: Free a buffer's data and its descriptor.

functions.name: buffAlloc2
functions.purpose: Allocate an array of n1 separately allocated buffers, each of size n2.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic; allocation failures are not checked.

functions.name: buffFree2
functions.purpose: Free each buffer in an array and then free the array.

functions.name: dctiv
functions.purpose: Apply an in-place one-dimensional type-IV DCT using a precomputed transform matrix.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Each output is accumulated in float in increasing input-index order; preserve multiplication and addition order and avoid unintended fused operations.

functions.name: dct
functions.signature: void dct(float *x, int n, float **c, int type);
functions.purpose: Apply an in-place forward or inverse one-dimensional DCT using a precomputed transform matrix.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Float products are accumulated in increasing input-index order; the inverse uses the transposed matrix, and any nonzero type selects it.

functions.name: dctiv_2
functions.signature: void dctiv_2(float **x, int n1, int n2, float **c1, float **c2);
functions.purpose: Apply an in-place two-dimensional type-IV DCT along the fast dimension and then the slow dimension.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The static dctiv_row helper accumulates float products in increasing slow-dimension input-index order; preserve dimension order and accumulation order.

functions.name: dct_2
functions.signature: void dct_2(float **x, int n1, int n2, float **c1, float **c2, int type);
functions.purpose: Apply an in-place forward or inverse two-dimensional DCT along the fast dimension and then the slow dimension.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The static dct_row helper accumulates float products in increasing slow-dimension input-index order; preserve dimension order, matrix orientation, and accumulation order.

functions.name: dctivAlloc
functions.purpose: Allocate and generate the transform matrix for a type-IV DCT.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses double sqrt and cos with double literals, but stores scaling factors and matrix entries as float; preserve intermediate conversions and expression order. Transcendental results may vary by math library.

functions.name: dctAlloc
functions.purpose: Allocate and generate the transform matrix for the forward and inverse DCT.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses double sqrt and cos with double literals, but stores scaling factors and matrix entries as float; preserve intermediate conversions and expression order. Transcendental results may vary by math library; n must be positive because row zero is written unconditionally.

functions.name: waveGetfilter
functions.purpose: Allocate a wavelet filter and populate its low-pass and reversed alternating-sign high-pass coefficients from the selected table.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Decimal table constants are converted to float; preserve their float values and the exact reversal and sign changes. IDs at or above NWAVETYPE return NULL, while negative IDs are not checked and cause undefined indexing.

functions.name: waveFreefilter
functions.purpose: Free both coefficient arrays and the wavelet filter descriptor.
